G4250.def:
**πρίν **
1. as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; [[3Ma.5.28|3Ma.5:28]] [[3Mac.6.4|3Mac 6:4]] [[3Mac.6.31|3Mac 6:31]])
2. As conic. (cl.), before;
(a) after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: [[Mat.26.34, 75|Mat.26:34, 75]], [[Mrk.14.72|Mrk.14:72]], [[Luk.22.61|Luk.22:61]], [[Jhn.4.49; 8.58|Jhn.4:49 8:58]] (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) [[Jhn.14.29|Jhn.14:29]], [[Act.2.20|Act.2:20]]" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]] [[Mrk.14.30|Mrk.14:30]], [[Act.2.20|Act.2:20]], WH, mg., [[Act.7.2|Act.7:2]]
(b) **after a negative sentence, πρὶν ἤ**: a. subjc. (before ἄν, M, _Pr._, 169), [[Luk.2.26|Luk.2:26]] with optative, [[Act.25.16|Act.25:16]]†
(AS)

G4254.def:
**προ-άγω **
[in LXX: [[1Sa.17.16|1Ki.17:16]] (נָגַשׁ), [[Wis.19.11|Wis.19:11]], al. ;]
1. prop. trans., **to lead on, lead forth or forward**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.16.30; 17.5|Act.16:30 17:5]]; of bringing forth to trial, [[Act.12.6|Act.12:6]] (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), [[Act.25.26|Act.25:26]]
2. Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi);
(a) to lead the way, [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]] (R, mg.), **hence, to go before, precede**: [[Luk.18.39|Luk.18:39]] opposite to ἀκολουθέω, [[Mrk.11.9|Mrk.11:9]] before εἰς, [[Mat.14.22|Mat.14:22]], [[Mrk.6.45|Mrk.6:45]], [[1Ti.5.24|1Ti.5:24]], [[Heb.7.18|Heb.7:18]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.2.9; 21.9|Mat.2:9 21:9]], [[Mrk.10.32|Mrk.10:32]]; before εἰς, [[Mat.21.31; 26.32; 28.7|Mat.21:31 26:32 28:7]], [[Mrk.14.28; 16.7|Mrk.14:28 16:7]];
(b) to go on, advance ([[Sir.20.27|Sir.20:27]]): [[2Jn.9|2Jn.9]].†
(AS)

G4241.def:
**πρέπω **
[in LXX: [[Psa.93.5|Psa.93:5]] (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;]
1. to be clearly seen.
2. to resemble.
3. **to be fitting or becoming, to suit**: with dative, [[Heb.7.26|Heb.7:26]], [[1Ti.2.10|1Ti.2:10]], [[Tit.2.1|Tit.2:1]]; impers., with dative, [[Eph.5.3|Eph.5:3]] id. before inf., [[Heb.2.10|Heb.2:10]] πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., [[Mat.3.15|Mat.3:15]] with accusative and inf., [[1Co.11.13|1Co.11:13]] (see Bl., § 72, 5).†
(AS)

G4260.def:
**προ-βαίνω **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
**to go forwards, go on, advance**: [[Mat.4.21|Mat.4:21]], [[Mrk.1.19|Mrk.1:19]]. Metaphorical, of age ([[Gen.18.11|Gen.18:11]], al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, [[Luk.1.7, 18; 2.36|Luk.1:7, 18 2:36]].†
(AS)

G4235.def:
**πρᾷος**, πρᾶος, see: πραΰς.
**πραΰς**, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. [[2Ma.15.12|2Ma.15:12]], -ᾷος, see Thackeray, _Gr._, 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;]
**gentle, meek**: [[Mat.5.5; 11.29; 21.5|Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5]]" (LXX) [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]]†
(AS)

G4253.def:
**πρό **
_prep. with genitive, _ [in LXX chiefly for פָּנִים ;]
**before**;
(a) **of place**: [[Act.12.6, 14; 14.13|Act.12:6, 14 14:13]], [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]]; π. προσώπου (= _Heb._ פָּנִים, [[Deu.3.18|Deu.3:18]], [[Mal.3.1|Mal.3:1]], al.; Bl., § 40, 9), [[Mat.11.10|Mat.11:10]], [[Mrk.1.2|Mrk.1:2]], [[Luk.1.76; 7.27; 9.52; 10.1|Luk.1:76 7:27 9:52 10:1]], [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]];
(b) **of time**: [[Mat.8.29; 24.38|Mat.8:29 24:38]], [[Luk.11.38; 21.12|Luk.11:38 21:12]], [[Jhn.11.55; 13.1; 17.24|Jhn.11:55 13:1 17:24]], [[Act.5.36; 21.38|Act.5:36 21:38]], [[1Co.2.7; 4.5|1Co.2:7 4:5]], [[Eph.1.4|Eph.1:4]], [[Col.1.17|Col.1:17]], [[2Ti.1.9; 4.21|2Ti.1:9 4:21]], [[Tit.1.2|Tit.1:2]], [[Heb.11.5|Heb.11:5]], [[1Pe.1.20|1Pe.1:20]], [[Jude.25|Ju 25]]; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, [[2Co.12.2|2Co.12:2]] π. προσώπου (see supr.), [[Act.13.24|Act.13:24]] with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.5.12|Mat.5:12]], [[Jhn.5.7; 10.8|Jhn.5:7 10:8]], [[Rom.16.7|Rom.16:7]], [[Gal.1.17|Gal.1:17]]; with genitive art. inf. (= πρίν; M, _Pr._, 100; Bl., § 69, 7), [[Mat.6.8|Mat.6:8]] [[Luk.2.21; 22.15|Luk.2:21 22:15]], [[Jhn.1.49; 13.19; 17.5|Jhn.1:49 13:19 17:5]], [[Act.23.15|Act.23:15]], [[Gal.2.12; 3.23|Gal.2:12 3:23]]; as in late writers (resembling a Latin idiom but indepen­dent of it; B1., § 40, 5; M, _Pr._, 100 f.; of. Am [[2Ma.15.36|2Ma.15:36]], and for other exx., Soph., _Lex._, see word), πρὸ ἓξ ἡμέρας τοῦ πάσχα, on the sixth day before the Passover, [[Jhn.12.1|Jhn.12:1]]
(with) **of preference**: π. πάντων, [[Jas.5.12|Jas.5:12]], [[1Pe.4.8|1Pe.4:8]];
(d) in compos.,
α with subst., of position before: προαύλιον, πρόδρομος; priority of rank or order, προπάτωρ; anticipation, πρό γνωσις, πρό νοια;
β with adj., intensity, πρόδηλος;
γ with verb., of place, προάγω, προβαίνω; of preference, προαιρέομαι.†
(AS)

G4263.def:
**πρόβατον**, -ου, τό
(προβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for שֶׂה, more rarely for כֶּבֶשׂ (כֶּשֶׂב), רָחֵל ;]
1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats.
2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), **a sheep**: [[Mat.7.15|Mat.7:15]], [[Mrk.6.34|Mrk.6:34]], al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, [[Rom.8.36|Rom.8:36]] (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: [[Mat.10.6; 15.24; 26.31|Mat.10:6 15:24 26:31]]" (LXX) [[Mrk.14.27|Mrk.14:27]] (LXX), [[Jhn.10.7-8, 15-16; 10.26-27; 21.16-17|Jhn.10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17]] (WH txt., προβάτια), [[Heb.13.20|Heb.13:20]] opposite to ἐρίφια, [[Mat.25.33|Mat.25:33]]
**προβάτιον**, -ου, τό,
dimin. of πρόβατον (used as a term of endearment, see El., § 27, 4), **a little sheep**: [[Jhn.21.16-17|Jhn.21:16-17]] (πρόβατα, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G4217.def:
**ποταπός**
(late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν, [in LXX: Dan LXX [[Sus.1.54|Su 1:54]]* ;]
1. (= ποδαπός) from what country?
2. **In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?**: [[Mat.8.27|Mat.8:27]], [[Mrk.13.1|Mrk.13:1]], [[Luk.1.29; 7.39|Luk.1:29 7:39]], [[2Pe.3.11|2Pe.3:11]], [[1Jn.3.1|1Jn.3:1]].†
(AS)

G4222.def:
**ποτίζω**
(πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi. ;]
**to give to drink**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.25.35, 37; 25.42; 27.48|Mat.25:35, 37 25:42 27:48]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Luk.13.15|Luk.13:15]], [[Rom.12.20|Rom.12:20]]; with dupl. accusative, [[Mat.10.42|Mat.10:42]], [[Mrk.9.41|Mrk.9:41]]; fig., γάλα, [[1Co.3.2|1Co.3:2]] ἐκ τ. οἴνου [[Rev.14.8|Rev.14:8]] of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; [[Gen.13.10|Gen.13:10]]), figuratively, [[1Co.3.6-8|1Co.3:6-8]] Metaphorical (cf. [[Isa.29.10|Isa.29:10]] [[Sir.15.3|Sir.15:3]]), of the Spirit, [[1Co.12.13|1Co.12:13]]†
(AS)

G4221.def:
**ποτήριον**, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:]
**a wine cup**: [[Mat.23.25-26; 26.27|Mat.23:25-26 26:27]], [[Mrk.7.4; 14.23|Mrk.7:4 14:23]], [[Luk.11.39; 22.17, 20|Luk.11:39 22:17, 20]] a (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[1Co.11.25|1Co.11:25]], [[Rev.17.4|Rev.17:4]]; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., [[1Co.11.28|1Co.11:28]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.10.42|Mat.10:42]], [[Mrk.9.41|Mrk.9:41]]; τ. εὐλογίας, [[1Co.10.16|1Co.10:16]] by meton., of the contents of the cup, [[Luk.22.20|Luk.22:20]] b (WH, R, mg., cm.), [[1Co.11.25-26;|1Co.11:25-26]] with genitive of person(s), [[1Co.10.21; 11.27|1Co.10:21 11:27]]. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity ([[Psa.16.5|Psa.16:5]], al.); of adversity ([[Psa.11.6|Psa.11:6]], [[Isa.51.17|Isa.51:17]], al.): of the sufferings of Christ, [[Mat.20.22-23; 26.39; 10.38-39; 14.36|Mat.20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36]], [[Luk.22.42|Luk.22:42]], [[Jhn.18.11|Jhn.18:11]]; of divine punishment, [[Rev.14.10; 16.19; 18.6|Rev.14:10 16:19 18:6]].†
(AS)

G4264.def:
**προ-βιβάζω ** causal of προβαίνω,
[in LXX: [[Exo.35.34|Exo.35:34]] (יָרָה hi.), [[Deu.6.7|Deu.6:7]] (שָׁנַן pi.) * ;]
**to lead forward, lead on**; metaphorically, **to induce, incite, urge**: [[Mat.14.8|Mat.14:8]]†
(AS)

G4245.def:
**πρέσβυς**, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): [[Num.21.20|Num.21:20]] (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), [[Isa.13.8; 57.9|Isa.13:8 57:9]] (צִיר), [[1Ma.9.70|1Ma.9:70]], al. ;]
an old man.
Compar.,
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;]
1. **of age, elder**: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., [[Luk.15.25|Luk.15:25]] as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, [[Act.2.17|Act.2:17]] to νεώτερος, [[1Ti.5.1-2;|1Ti.5:1-2]] of the religious leaders of the past, [[Mat.15.2|Mat.15:2]], [[Mrk.7.3|Mrk.7:3]], 5, [[Heb.11.2|Heb.11:2]] (= οἱ πατέρες, [[Heb.1.1|Heb.1:1]]).
2. **Of dignity, rank or office **(as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; _LAE_, 373);
(a) **among Jews**: [[Mat.16.21; 26.47, 57; 27.3, 12; 27.20, 41; 28.12|Mat.16:21 26:47, 57 27:3, 12 27:20, 41 28:12]], [[Mrk.8.31; 11.27; 14.43, 53; 15.1|Mrk.8:31 11:27 14:43, 53 15:1]], [[Luk.7.3; 9.22; 20.1; 22.52|Luk.7:3 9:22 20:1 22:52]], [[Jhn.8.9|Jhn.8:9]], [[Act.4.5, 8; 4.23; 6.12; 23.14; 24.1|Act.4:5, 8 4:23 6:12 23:14 24:1]]; τ. Ἰουνδαίων, [[Act.25.15|Act.25:15]] τ. λαοῦ, [[Mat.21.23; 26.3; 27.1|Mat.21:23 26:3 27:1]];
(b) **among Christians**: [[Act.11.30; 14.23; 15.2, 4; 15.6, 22-23; 16.4; 21.18|Act.11:30 14:23 15:2, 4 15:6, 22-23 16:4 21:18]], [[1Ti.5.17; 5.19|1Ti.5:17 5:19]], [[Tit.1.5|Tit.1:5]], [[2Jn.1|II Jn 1]], [[3Jn.1|3Jn.1]], [[1Pe.5.1; 5.5|1Pe.5:1 5:5]]; τ. ἐκκλησίας, [[Act.20.17|Act.20:17]], [[Jas.5.14|Jas.5:14]];
(with) **in the visions of the Apocalypse**: [[Rev.4.4, 10; 5.5-6, 8; 5.11, 14; 7.11, 13; 11.16; 14.3; 19.4|Rev.4:4, 10 5:5-6, 8 5:11, 14 7:11, 13 11:16 14:3 19:4]].
(On the NT use of this word and its relation to ἐπίσκοπος (which see), cf. Lft., Phi., 93 ff., 189 ff.; CGT, Past. Epp., lvi ff.) †
(AS)

G4206.def:
**πόρρω **
_adv._ (in older Attic, πρόσω), [in LXX for רָחוֹק, etc. ;]
**far off**: [[Mat.15.8|Mat.15:8]], [[Mrk.7.6|Mrk.7:6]]" (LXX), [[Luk.14.32|Luk.14:32]] comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), [[Luk.24.28|Luk.24:28]]†
(AS)

G4234.def:
**πρᾶξις**, -εως, ἡ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: [[2Ch.13.22; 27.7; 28.26|2Ch.13:22 27:7 28:26]] (דֶּרֶךְ), [[Job.24.5|Job.24:5]] A (פֹּעַל), [[Pro.13.13|Pro.13:13]], [[Wis.9.11|Wis.9:11]], al. ;]
1. **a doing, deed, act**: [[Mat.16.27|Mat.16:27]] pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): [[Luk.23.51|Luk.23:51]] p1., [[Rom.8.13|Rom.8:13]], [[Col.3.9|Col.3:9]]; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), [[Act.19.18|Act.19:18]]
2. **an acting, action, business, function**: [[Rom.12.4|Rom.12:4]]†
(AS)

G4229.def:
**πρᾶγμα**, -τος, τύ
(πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר ;]
1. **that which has been done, a deed, act**: [[Luk.1.1|Luk.1:1]], [[Act.5.4|Act.5:4]], [[2Co.7.11|2Co.7:11]], [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]].
2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), **hence, a thing, matter, affair**: [[Mat.18.19|Mat.18:19]], [[Rom.16.2|Rom.16:2]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (see M, _Th._, in l), [[Heb.10.1; 11.1|Heb.10:1 11:1]], [[Jas.3.16|Jas.3:16]]; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), **a law-suit**: [[1Co.6.1|1Co.6:1]]†
(AS)

G4280.def:
**προ-ερέω**, -ῶ, see: προεῖπον.
**προ-εῖπον ** 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα ([[3Ma.6.35|3Ma.6:35]] *), pass., -είρημαι ([[2Ma.2.32|2Ma.2:32]], [[3Ma.1.26|3Ma.1:26]], al.),
1. **to say before**: [[Gal.1.9|Gal.1:9]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (on the form -αμεν, see WH, _App._, 164), [[Heb.4.7|Heb.4:7]] before ὅτι, [[2Co.7.3; 13.2|2Co.7:3 13:2]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]]; of prophecy, [[Mat.24.25|Mat.24:25]], [[Mrk.13.23|Mrk.13:23]], [[Act.1.16|Act.1:16]], [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]], [[2Pe.3.2|2Pe.3:2]], [[Jude.17|Ju 17]].
2. **to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly **(cl.): so R, mg., in [[2Co.13.2|2Co.13:2]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, _Th._, 38).†
(AS)

G4281.def:
**προ-έρχομαι **
[in LXX: [[Gen.33.3, 14|Gen.33:3, 14]] R (עָבַר), [[Jdt.2.19|Jdth.2:19]], [[Sir.35.10|Sir.35:10]] ([[Sir.32.10|Sir.32:10]]) al ;]
1. **to go forward, go on, advance**: before μικρόν, [[Mat.26.39|Mat.26:39]] and [[Mrk.14.35|Mrk.14:35]] (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]]
2. **Of relative position, to go before, precede**: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), [[Luk.22.47|Luk.22:47]] (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, [[Luk.1.17|Luk.1:17]] (cf. [[Gen.33.3|Gen.33:3]]).
3. **Of time, to go before or in advance**: [[Act.20.5, 13|Act.20:5, 13]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[2Co.9.5|2Co.9:5]] with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), [[Mrk.6.33|Mrk.6:33]]†
(AS)

G4289.def:
**πρόθυμος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[1Ch.28.21|1Ch.28:21]], [[2Ch.29.31|2Ch.29:31]] (נָדִיב), [[Hab.1.8|Hab.1:8]] (חוּשׁ), al. ;]
**willing, ready**: [[Mat.26.41|Mat.26:41]], [[Mrk.14.38|Mrk.14:38]]; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., [[3Ma.5.26|3Ma.5:26]]), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., [[Rom.1.15|Rom.1:15]] (but see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4232.def:
**πραιτώριον**, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium)
1. **headquarters in a Roman camp, **
2. **The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province**: [[Mat.27.27|Mat.27:27]], [[Mrk.15.16|Mrk.15:16]] (see Swete, in l), [[Jhn.18.28, 33; 19.9|Jhn.18:28, 33 19:9]]; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, [[Act.23.35|Act.23:35]]
3. **the Prætorian Guard**: [[Php.1.13|Php.1:13]] (see Lft., in l; _ICC_, 51 f.).†
(AS)

G4237.def:
**πρασιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Sir.24.31|Sir.24:31]] * ;]
**a garden-bed**; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: [[Mrk.6.40|Mrk.6:40]]†
(AS)

G4209.def:
**πορφύρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן, אַרְגְּוָן ;]
1. the purple fish (cf. [[1Ma.4.23|1Ma.4:23]]).
2. purple dye.
3. **Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment**: [[Mrk.15.17, 20|Mrk.15:17, 20]], [[Luk.16.19|Luk.16:19]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]].†
(AS)

G4246.def:
**πρεσβύτης**, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן, [[Gen.25.8|Gen.25:8]], al.; also (= πρεσβευτής), [[2Ch.32.31|2Ch.32:31]] Bl (לוּץ), [[1Ma.14.22|1Ma.14:22]] S, al. (see Thackeray, _Gr._, 97) ;]
1. **an old man**: [[Luk.1.18|Luk.1:18]], [[Tit.2.2|Tit.2:2]], Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.).
2. **As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador**: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4298.def:
**προ-κόπτω **
[in Sm.: [[Psa.45.5|Psa.45:5]] * ;]
to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., **to advance, progress**: of time, [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]] Metaphorical, [[Luk.2.52|Luk.2:52]], [[Gal.1.14|Gal.1:14]], [[2Ti.2.16; 3.9; 3.13|2Ti.2:16 3:9 3:13]].†
(AS)

G4238.def:
**πράσσω **
(Att.. -ττω, and so [[Act.17.7|Act.17:7]] Rec.; cf. M, _Pr._, 25, 45), [in LXX chiefly for עָשָׂה, פָּעַל ;]
= Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere,
1. **to do, practise, be engaged in**: [[Act.19.19, 36|Act.19:19, 36]], [[1Co.9.17|1Co.9:17]]; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), [[1Th.4.11|1Th.4:11]] intrans., to act, [[Act.17.7|Act.17:7]]
2. **to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform**: [[Act.26.20, 26|Act.26:20, 26]] [[Rom.7.15; 9.11|Rom.7:15 9:11]], [[2Co.5.10|2Co.5:10]], [[Php.4.9|Php.4:9]]; νόμον (_ICC_, in l), [[Rom.2.25|Rom.2:25]] of unworthy acts (for WH. usually ποιέω in cl.), **to commit, do**: [[Luk.22.23; 23.41|Luk.22:23 23:41]], [[Jhn.3.20; 5.29|Jhn.3:20 5:29]], [[Act.3.17; 5.35; 16.28; 25.11, 25; 26.9, 31|Act.3:17 5:35 16:28 25:11, 25 26:9, 31]], [[Rom.1.32|Rom.1:32]] (_ICC_, in l), [[Rom.2.1-3; 7.19; 13.4|Rom.2:1-3 7:19 13:4]], [[1Co.5.2|1Co.5:2]], [[2Co.12.21|2Co.12:21]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]].
3. **to transact, manage, hence, of payment, to exact **(cl.): [[Luk.3.13; 19.23|Luk.3:13 19:23]].
4. Reflexively, of state or condition, to do or fare Æsch., Hdt., al.): [[Eph.6.21|Eph.6:21]] εὖ π. (see M, _Pr._, 228 f.), [[Act.15.29|Act.15:29]]†
_SYN._: see: ποιέω (AS)

G4233.def:
**πράκτωρ**, -ορος, ὁ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: [[Isa.3.12|Isa.3:12]] (נָגַשׁ) * ;]
1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes.
2. In Athens, **one who exacts payment, a collector**; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), **a court officer**: [[Luk.12.58|Luk.12:58]]†
(AS)

G4242.def:
**πρεσβεία**, -ας, ἡ
(πρεσβεύω), [in LXX: [[2Ma.4.11|2Ma.4:11]] * ;]
1. age, seniority.
2. rank, dignity.
3. **an embassy**; by meton., of the am­bassadors, **embassy**: [[Luk.14.32; 19.14|Luk.14:32 19:14]].†
(AS)

G4207.def:
**πόρρωθεν **
_adv._ (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;]
**from afar**: [[Luk.17.12|Luk.17:12]], [[Heb.11.13|Heb.11:13]].†
(AS)

G4231.def:
**πραγματεύομαι**
(πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: [[1Ki.10.22|3Ki.10:22]] B, [[1Ki.9.19|3Ki.9:19]] A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;]
1. to busy oneself.
2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: [[Luk.19.13|Luk.19:13]] (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†
(AS)

G4261.def:
**προ-βάλλω **
[in LXX for חוּד, מָרַק, etc. ;]
1. to throw before.
2. **to put forward**: with accusative, [[Act.19.33|Act.19:33]] of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), [[Luk.21.30|Luk.21:30]]†
(AS)

G4244.def:
**πρεσβυτέριον**, -ου, τό
(πρεσβύτερος) [in LXX: Da TH [[Sus.1.50|Su 1:50]] A * ;]
**a body of elders, presbytery**: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), [[Luk.22.66|Luk.22:66]], [[Act.22.5|Act.22:5]]; of Christian presbyters, [[1Ti.4.14|1Ti.4:14]]†
(AS)

G4262.def:
**προβατικός**, -ή, -όν
(πρόβατον) [in LXX (π. πύλη): [[Neh.3.1, 32; 12.39|Neh.3:1, 32 12:39]] (צֹאן)* ;]
**of sheep**: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]]†
(AS)

G4213.def:
**πόσις**, -εως, ἡ
(πίνω), [in LXX: Da, LXX TH [[Dan.1.10|Dan.1:10]] (מִשְׁתֶּה) * ;]
1. prop., **drinking**: [[Rom.14.17|Rom.14:17]], [[Col.2.16|Col.2:16]] (see Lft.; _ICC_, in l).
2. **= πόμα, drink**: [[Jhn.6.55|Jhn.6:55]] (cf. βρῶσις).†
(AS)

G4220.def:
**πότερος**, -α, -ον
which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, **whether**: [[Jhn.7.17|Jhn.7:17]]†
(AS)

G4210.def:
**πορφύρεος**, -α, -ον contr., -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ποπφύρα), [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן ;]
**purple**: [[Jhn.19.2|Jhn.19:2]], 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), [[Rev.17.4; 18.6|Rev.17:4 18:6]].†
(AS)

G4293.def:
**προ-κατ-αγγέλλω **
**to announce beforehand**: with accusative and inf., [[Act.3.18|Act.3:18]] before περί, [[Act.7.52|Act.7:52]]†
(AS)

G4296.def:
**προ-κηρύσσω **
1. to proclaim by herald.
2. **Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim**: [[Act.13.24|Act.13:24]]†
(AS)

G4252.def:
**Πρίσκιλλα**, see: Πρίσκα.
**Πρίσκα**, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, **Prisca**: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)

G4201.def:
**Πόρκιος**, -ου, ὁ
**Porcius**, prænomen of Porcius Festus (see: Φῆστος): [[Act.24.27|Act.24:27]]†
(AS)

G4267.def:
**προ-γινώσκω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.6.13; 8.8; 18.6|Wis.6:13 8:8 18:6]] * ;]
**to know beforehand, foreknow**: [[2Pe.3.17|2Pe.3:17]] with accusative of person(s), [[Act.26.5|Act.26:5]] of the Divine foreknowledge, [[Rom.8.29; 11.2|Rom.8:29 11:2]], [[1Pe.1.20|1Pe.1:20]].†
(AS)

G4223.def:
**Ποτίολοι**, -ων, οἱ
Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: [[Act.28.13|Act.28:13]]†
(AS)

G4279.def:
**προ-επ-αγγέλλω **
to announce before. Mid., **to promise before**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.1.2|Rom.1:2]], [[2Co.9.5|2Co.9:5]] (Dio. Cass.).†
(AS)

G4284.def:
**προ-έχω **
[in LXX: [[Job.27.6|Job.27:6]] A (חָזַק hi.) * ;]
1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, **to excuse oneself**: [[Rom.3.9|Rom.3:9]], R, mg. (but see Field, _Notes_, 152 f.; Lft., _Notes_, 266 f.; _ICC_ and Vau., in l).
2. Intrans.
(a) **to project**;
(b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, **to excel**: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).†
(AS)

G4266.def:
**προ-γίνομαι **
[in LXX: [[Wis.19.13|Wis.19:13]] אA, [[2Ma.14.3|2Ma.14:3]] [[2Mac.15.8|2Mac 15:8]] * ;]
**to happen before**: pf. pass. ptcp., [[Rom.3.25|Rom.3:25]]†
(AS)

G4225.def:
**πού **
enclitic particle,
1. **anywhere, somewhere**: [[Heb.2.6; 4.4|Heb.2:6 4:4]].
2. **in some degree, perhaps, about**: [[Act.27.29|Act.27:29]] (T, μήπου), [[Rom.4.19|Rom.4:19]] δή που (T, δήπου), **surely**: [[Heb.2.16|Heb.2:16]]†
(AS)

G4282.def:
**προ-ετοιμάζω **
[in LXX: [[Isa.28.24|Isa.28:24]] B, [[Wis.9.8|Wis.9:8]] * ;]
**to prepare before**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Rom.9.23|Rom.9:23]] (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), [[Eph.2.10|Eph.2:10]]†
(AS)

G4272.def:
**προ-δίδωμι **
[in LXX: [[Ezk.16.34|Eze.16:34]] A (נָתַן), [[4Ma.4.1|4Ma.4:1]], al. ;]
1. **to give before, give first**: [[Rom.11.35|Rom.11:35]] ([[Job.41.2|Job.41:2]] (11) LXX, al.).
2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G4291.def:
**προ-ΐστημι **
[in LXX: [[2Ki.13.17|2Ki.13:17]], [[Pro.23.5; 26.17|Pro.23:5 26:17]], [[Isa.43.24|Isa.43:24]], [[Amo.6.10|Amo.6:10]] (no proper _Heb._ equiv.), [[Bel.1.7|Dan LXX Bel 1:7]], [[1Ma.5.19|1Ma.5:19]], [[4Ma.11.27|4Ma.11:27]] * ;]
1. trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.).
2. Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.;
(a) **to preside, rule, govern**: [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]], [[1Ti.5.17|1Ti.5:17]]; with genitive, [[1Th.5.12|1Th.5:12]], [[1Ti.3.4-5; 3.12|1Ti.3:4-5 3:12]];
(b) **to direct, maintain**: with genitive of thing(s), καλῶν ἔργων, [[Tit.3.8, 14|Tit.3:8, 14]] (on R, mg., profess honest occupations, see CGT, in l; Field, _Notes_, 223 f.).†
(AS)

G4285.def:
**προ-ηγέσμαι **
[in LXX: [[Deu.20.9|Deu.20:9]] (בְּרוֹשׁ), [[Pro.17.14|Pro.17:14]] (פָּנִים), [[2Ma.4.40|2Ma.4:40]], al. ;]
1. **to go before as leader **(in cl., with genitive, dative): [[Rom.12.10|Rom.12:10]] (Chrys., Vg., al.; see _ICC_, in l).
2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (_ICC_, cf. [[1Th.5.13|1Th.5:13]], [[Php.2.3|Php.2:3]] and EV "preferring").†
(AS)

G4270.def:
**προ-γράφω **
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., [[1Ma.10.36|1Ma.10:36]] * ;]
1. **to write before**: [[Rom.15.4|Rom.15:4]], [[Eph.3.3|Eph.3:3]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]].
2. **to write in public, placard, proclaim **(Dem., Plut., al.): [[Gal.3.1|Gal.3:1]] (Lft., in l).
3. **= ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict**: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, _Notes_, 189; CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G4251.def:
**Πρίσκα**, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, **Prisca**: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)

G4236.def:
**πρᾳότης**, πραότης, see: πραΰτης.
**πραΰτης**
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: [[Psa.45.4; 90.10; 132.1|Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1]] (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, [[Est.5.1|Est.5:1]], [[Sir.6.1-37|Sir.6:1-37]] * ;]
**gentleness, meekness**: [[1Co.4.21|1Co.4:21]], [[2Co.10.1|2Co.10:1]], [[Gal.5.23; 6.1|Gal.5:23 6:1]], [[Eph.4.2|Eph.4:2]], [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]] (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, [[Tit.3.2|Tit.3:2]], [[Jas.1.21; 3.13|Jas.1:21 3:13]], [[1Pe.3.15|1Pe.3:15]].†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v
(AS)

G4203.def:
**πορνεύω **
[in LXX for זָנָה ;]
1. to prostitute the body for hire.
2. **to commit fornication**: [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]] (WH, mg), [[1Co.6.18; 10.8|1Co.6:18 10:8]], [[Rev.2.14, 20|Rev.2:14, 20]]. Metaphorical (as in LXX: [[1Ch.5.25|1Ch.5:25]], [[Jer.3.6|Jer.3:6]], [[Hos.9.1|Hos.9:1]], al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), [[Rev.17.2; 18.3, 9|Rev.17:2 18:3, 9]] (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).†
(AS)

G4243.def:
**πρεσβεύω**
(πρέσβυς),
1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
2. **to be an ambassador **(see: πρεσβύτης): [[2Co.5.20|2Co.5:20]], [[Eph.6.20|Eph.6:20]].†
(AS)

G4278.def:
**προ-ενάρχομαι **
**to begin before**: [[2Co.8.6|2Co.8:6]] with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, [[2Co.8.10|2Co.8:10]] (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G4295.def:
**πρό-κειμαι **
[in LXX: [[Exo.39.18|Exo.39:18]] (36), [[Num.4.7|Num.4:7]] (פָּנִים), etc. ;]
used as pass. of προτίθημι;
1. **to be set before one, to be set forth**: [[Heb.6.18; 12.1-2|Heb.6:18 12:1-2]], [[Jude.7|Ju 7]].
2. **to present oneself, be present**: [[2Co.8.12|2Co.8:12]] (see Mey., in l).†
(AS)

G4255.def:
**προ-αιρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;]
to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., **to take by choice, prefer, propose**: [[2Co.9.7|2Co.9:7]]†
(AS)

G4287.def:
**προ-θέσμιος**, -α, -ον
[in Sm.: [[Job.28.3|Job.28:3]], [[Dan.9.26|Dan.9:26]] * ;]
appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), **a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time**: [[Gal.4.2|Gal.4:2]]†
(AS)

G4277.def:
**προ-εῖπον ** 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα ([[3Ma.6.35|3Ma.6:35]] *), pass., -είρημαι ([[2Ma.2.32|2Ma.2:32]], [[3Ma.1.26|3Ma.1:26]], al.),
1. **to say before**: [[Gal.1.9|Gal.1:9]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (on the form -αμεν, see WH, _App._, 164), [[Heb.4.7|Heb.4:7]] before ὅτι, [[2Co.7.3; 13.2|2Co.7:3 13:2]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]]; of prophecy, [[Mat.24.25|Mat.24:25]], [[Mrk.13.23|Mrk.13:23]], [[Act.1.16|Act.1:16]], [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]], [[2Pe.3.2|2Pe.3:2]], [[Jude.17|Ju 17]].
2. **to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly **(cl.): so R, mg., in [[2Co.13.2|2Co.13:2]], [[Gal.5.21|Gal.5:21]], [[1Th.4.6|1Th.4:6]] (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, _Th._, 38).†
(AS)

G4292.def:
**προ-καλέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.8.11|2Ma.8:11]] A * ;]
to call forth.
Most frequently in mid.,
(a) **to challenge; hence, to provoke**: [[Gal.5.26|Gal.5:26]]
(b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G4297.def:
**προ-κοπή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(προκόπτω), [in LXX: [[Sir.51.17|Sir.51:17]], [[2Ma.8.8|2Ma.8:8]] * ;]
**progress **(prop., on a journey, then generally): [[Php.1.12, 25|Php.1:12, 25]], [[1Ti.4.15|1Ti.4:15]] (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 158).†
(AS)

G4269.def:
**πρό-γονος**, -ον
(προγίνομαι), [in LXX: [[Est.4.17|Est.4:17]], [[Sir.8.4|Sir.8:4]], al. ;]
1. born before.
2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., **ancestors, forefathers**: [[2Ti.1.3|2Ti.1:3]] of living parents (so Plat.), [[1Ti.5.4|1Ti.5:4]]†
(AS)

G4299.def:
**πρό-κριμα**, -τος, τό
(cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand),
**pre-judging, prejudice**: [[1Ti.5.21|1Ti.5:21]] (see Cremer, 378).†
(AS)

G4200.def:
**πορισμός**, -ου, ὁ
(πορίζω, to procure), [in LXX: [[Wis.13.19; 14.2|Wis.13:19 14:2]] * ;]
1. a providing.
2. **a means of gain**: [[1Ti.6.5-6|1Ti.6:5-6]] (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4230.def:
**πραγματία** (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;]
1. careful application, hard work.
2. **business, occupation**: pl., [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]]†
(AS)

G4227.def:
**Πούδης**
(in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin)
**Pudens**: [[2Ti.4.21|2Ti.4:21]]†
(AS)

G4247.def:
**πρεσβῦτις**, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of πρεσβύτης,
[in LXX: [[4Ma.16.14|4Ma.16:14]] * ;]
**an aged woman**: [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]]†
(AS)

G4274.def:
**πρό-δρομος**, -ον
(προτρέχω) [in LXX: [[Num.13.21|Num.13:21]] (20), [[Isa.28.4|Isa.28:4]] (בִּכּוּר), [[Wis.12.8|Wis.12:8]] * ;]
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., **an advance guard, forerunner**: [[Heb.6.20|Heb.6:20]]†
(AS)

G4249.def:
**πρίζω** = πρίω,
[in LXX: [[Amo.1.3|Amo.1:3]], Da TH [[Sus.1.59|Su 1:59]] * ;]
**to saw, saw asunder **(= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]] (cf. δια-πρίω).†
(AS)

G4224.def:
**πότος**, -ου, ὁ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה ;]
**a drinking bout, carousal**: [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]]†
_SYN._: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

G4290.def:
**προθύμως **
[in LXX: [[2Ch.29.34|2Ch.29:34]] (יָשָׁר לֵבָב), [[Tob.7.8|Tob.7:8]], al. ;]
**eagerly, readily, with a ready mind**: [[1Pe.5.2|1Pe.5:2]]†
(AS)

G4216.def:
**ποταμο-φόρητος**, -ον
**carried away by a stream**:
[[Rev.12.15|Rev.12:15]] (for two exx. in π., see MM, xxi).†
(AS)
